# Futter für die Tiere Gnadenhöfe sind oftmals die einzige Heimat, die Tiere, die keinen "Nutzen" mehr haben, aufnehmen. Gnadenhöfe finanzieren sich rein über Spenden. Gerade vor dem Winter, wenn die Wiesen nichts mehr hergeben und das Futter aufgefüllt werden muss, sind die Kassen knapp. Gerade gab es auf Facebook wieder einen Aufruf für einen Gnadenhof aus Crumstadt, dem ich gerne mit der Novemberspende folge.
# Feed for the animals Animal sanctuaries are often the only homes that take in animals that no longer have any ‘use’. Animal sanctuaries are financed purely by donations. Especially before winter, when the meadows are empty and food needs to be replenished, funds are tight. There has just been another appeal on Facebook for an animal sanctuary in Crumstadt, which I am happy to follow with my November donation.
___ ___ ___
# Über hive.helps: @hive.helps ist ein Hive-Account der ähnlich einer Stiftung Gelder in Form von HBD oder Hive einsammelt, um diese in HBD Savings anzulegen und aus diesen Spenden an gemeinnützige Vereine und Organisationen zu vergeben. Zusätzlich kuratiert der Account täglich Artikel auf Hive von Menschen, die sich auf ihre Art für andere einsetzen. Mehr zur Idee von @hive.helps findet ihr im Vorstellungsartikel des Accounts. Gerne begrüßen wir Euch auf unserem Discord, den wir uns mit Hive Learn & more teilen.
# About hive.helps: @hive.helps is a Hive account that collects funds in the form of HBD or Hive, similar to a foundation, in order to invest them in HBD Savings and use them to make donations to charitable associations and organisations. In addition, the account curates daily articles on Hive from people who are committed to helping others in their own way. You can find out more about the idea behind @hive.helps in the first article introducing the account. We would like to welcome you to our Discord, which we share with Hive Learn & more.
___
# Wie könnt ihr helfen? Ihr könnt helfen, indem ihr: - @hive.helps folgt - unserem curation trail folgt - die Posts Upvoted und reblogged - selbst über die Initiative schreibt - HP an @hive.helps delegiert - SPS an @hive.helps spenden - oder sogar HBD oder Hive an @hive.helps sendet. Es wird genau festgehalten, wenn HBD oder Hive gesendet werden. Sollte das Projekt wieder erwarten nicht fortgeführt, werden alle Spenden zurücküberwiesen. Derzeit können leider keine Spendenbescheinigungen ausgestellt werden. Es wird gerade geprüft, ab wann es sich lohnen würde eine gemeinnützige GmbH zu gründen, um eine höhere Verbindlichkeit und steuerliche Vorteile zu erzeugen.
# How can you help? You can help by: - following @hive.helps - follow our curation trail - upvoting and reblogging the posts - writing about the initiative yourself - delegating HP to @hive.helps - donate SPS to @hive.helps - or even sending HBD or Hive to @hive.helps. It will be recorded exactly when HBD or Hive are sent. If the project is discontinued, all donations will be returned. Unfortunately, donation receipts cannot be issued at present. We are currently examining when it would be worthwhile to establish a non-profit limited company in order to create a higher liability and tax advantages.

author: tayo6
body:
**Hospitals, Blood and Cells - My November Highlight** 

November, for me, is going like any other month. Work, surprise, work, work, more work again. Also, as usual, by the second week of the month I'm just trying to get by, get to the end of the month. One thing however, happened in the second week of November. My sister was booked for an elective cesarean section, so she needed someone to donate a pint of blood in case the need for blood arose. I volunteered.

Prior to that moment I had never donated blood. I heard a story of someone who donated blood and was about to leave the hospital when he collapsed. They had to transfuse his blood back into him. Whether this is true or false, I don't know, but I became apprehensive.


![hospital-1802679_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tayo6/23zbPm3MAsNE5Ca7DvZDiohPZPFYxt2Tmg42ofwUu9H1ihQPEtVNyqFq23dBi2zcrHDQa.jpg)
>[Image Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/hospital-bed-doctor-surgery-1802679/)

Anyway, Tuesday 12th November, I went to the hospital with my sister. Immediately we drove into the premises, the familiar smell I hated so much greeted me. It wasn't pungent. It's the mild smell of pills and potions that makes the air sterile. I don't like sterile, I like creative and reproductive. The smell reminded me of painful childhood memories when I had to see the doctor at the Nigeria Police dispensary in Yola. The doctor,ever smiling, brown teeth contrasting sharply with his white coat. The doctor who poured a half bottle of hydrogen peroxide into a hole in my knee and didn't cringe when brownish-white foam shot out of the sore. That was what the hospital reminded me of that fateful Tuesday.

We made our way to the maternity ward where she signed herself in before we made our way to the phlebotomy lab. There, we found a queue. Most of the people there looked pissed, but one man was different. He was heavy-set, dark complexioned and balding at the crown. One could hardly read the expression on his face. Just when you think it's fear, it changes to resignation, then determination and so on, but not anger. He had with him a little of people who wanted to donate blood for his child, a sickle cell patient. 


![donation-5053770_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tayo6/23ynUGrDbkcChUDmJudGM8P22c3DK1ns1M53jSf7YCPkLNakdt3iwGnpVyLBY43W32DQL.jpg)
>[Image Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/donation-donate-plasma-donor-life-5053770/)

In my presence, while I waited for my turn, they tested all the people who were with, about seven of them, none of them was a match!

I got tested and they began to draw blood from me, I then struck a conversation with the lab technologist about the situation of the man outside. He told me that the man’s child is a certain blood group, and they needed a genotype AA blood for the child. I was surprised. All my life, I thought both blood group and genotype have to match for transfusion to take place. I learnt that only the blood group is required to match, but I  this case, the child needs AA genotype blood as that will help the child to heal.

“Can you take two pints from me, then?” I asked, by now, my fear was gone as I watched my blood flow into the sachet by the foot of the bench. “You can help another sickle cell patient that needs it.”


![IMG_20220703_072730.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tayo6/23xei2FVf298PPXwUrXMX9sZREtrxbxaANFb3tn7zMyhLD9hfyKSrabKXg8zA96a2x5zt.jpg)

First he told me that he can't risk taking two pints of blood at that time. He then asked me when I tested for genotype. That was when I told him that the first one I did certified me AS, the second test result said AA. Technologist urged me to do a third test and if it's AA, I should look for patients myself in the wards, if I want to donate because any blood I donate via the hospital will be sold to the patient at full price.

My spirit sank when I saw how people suffer from sickle cell. I couldn't bear to stay longer than I should in the hospital.

PS - My sister gave birth the following day. I've gone to renew my ‘uncle’ title at the Local Government Area office.

![IMG-20241126-WA0000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tayo6/23ynafrDpawTS4FgT6xFi76feQEQ6kSPHnXBtqwJoUeF2D4oyADr3tPnA1eK5EEr4F3vp.jpg)
>About to get 'em offering at the naming ceremony of my nephew.

author: kbv.animalwelf
body:
Wow! I was just overwhelmed by the amount of care and support that we received when we put out the message across all of our social media regarding the fur-covered minor-celebrity of Tiger Cave Temple and how he was unwell and missing. He was found the next day and escorted off the Tiger Cave Temple viewpoint by some concerned volunteers. We went to pick him up and gave him the VIP treatment. I was pleased to discover that the rumors of him having a bad temper now turned out to be untrue. It probably helped that I came offering really tasty treats to help ease him through the process though.
![image.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmW2SwkfEqhaPrGZSNzyfg8XSNek1JJt7z9VmEURpwBszw/image.png)
We didn't know for sure until yesterday evening but we had seen photos of how skinny he had become and how he was being more stand-offish of people approaching him over the past month or so, but I hadn't seen it with my own eyes until the past 24 hours. He wasn't as bad off as I had expected but he is still noticeably smaller than the last time I saw him.
![image.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmSspXiJKEkdVmW1VAbktqsjVMMEUuk99pLJPaw1H6e9hW/image.png)
To be honest, Panther is nearly an ideal weight but it is just the exposed ribs that concern us a bit. Many people have the wrong impression about what a dog should weigh and most pet owners actually over-feed their animals to the point where they are actually harming them by doing so. For us, it was the change in friendly attitude that was more alarming to us than the weight loss. Panther does do a ton of cardio afterall because he chooses to live in an area that has over 1200 steps leading to it.
![image.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmeZLSk8UiQqnADay6mzon9cTkK7NgsDiwm15afi7xcWCk/image.png)
Although my camera isn't the best and this pic is out of focus, you can tell by the hind-legs beg that Panther is quite comfortable around us and was nothing other than very friendly the entire time. We did some blood tests and are doing more later but found that he has two different blood parasites. He tested positive for anaplasmosis and Ehrlichiosis both of which are tick-borne diseases that are very curable. This is something that is quite unlikely to actually result in a dog's death, but it diminishes their quality of life because it suppresses their appetite, among other things, and by not eating, their general energy levels drop a dramatic amount. This is likely why he was a bit grouchy when people would approach him in the past month or so. Just think about it: Have you ever snapped out at someone because you were hungry and tired? Well that is what Panther has been going through. He's still the same sociable pup, he was just tired and hungry, didn't understand what was wrong with him, and wanted to be left alone to rest. The treatment involves a lot of medication and some hands on treatment and we estimate that he will be back to 100% in about a month. This can be problematic because Panther tends to like to be a "lone wolf" and will isolate himself at the temple grounds and we may not be able to find him if we put him back. We are going to keep him with us for a while to keep an eye on him in the meantime.
if you would like to see how you can help out or simply spread the word, please visit our website at

http://krabianimalwelfare.org

![21462758_174743779763179_4154543215066704521_n.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmXHEhXj4e6AzsbAJKsFo8csozuoq1uUcMSdFQTYifzi55/21462758_174743779763179_4154543215066704521_n.jpg)

body:
Greeting to you all.
Our mission to Rejoice academy Less privilege school and orphanage home

 https://img.inleo.io/DQmcVU6SbUPRpjaiXBUVPaVNfcpVUT1TYb89ZuRaS7isxYN/1732107782140.jpg 
 https://img.inleo.io/DQmUz3WrqsANbp34jwe8JYtuvFpjrdjrWwZYPynEfHDHh6a/1732107660612.jpg 
### mine picture 
 in New Nyanya, Abuja was glorious.
On a beautiful Saturday afternoon our team embarked on a journey to visit the orphans and less privileged individuals at a local care center in New Nyanya, Abuja.
The center, which is home to over 50 children, provides a safe paradise for those who have been abandoned, orphaned, or neglected. As we interacted with the children, we were struck by their  hope and joy, despite the challenges they face.
God created us to be our brothers keepers.
God created you not to satisfy only yourself but to please him and to satisfy others too.
Having a lot of money, driving  good cars and owning houses and eating alone doesn't mean someone has fulfilled his or her destiny because all this are for the fellow 's pleasure.Destiny is not be measured by how much money you have or how powerful you become.It is measured by the degree to which you are doing the will of God through charity or showing love to people and the Less privilege, orphans, widows etc.
My father sgt.Moses Ochayis said, "The poorest man on the earth is the richest man who is stingy"
It is good to be rich, famous and powerful, but even when those things come, you will still not be fulfilled unless you do the will of God by touching the lives of others through your charity work by reaching out to them in all locations.
Don't chase Shadows.Chase putting smiles on people's faces and bless their lives, that is what brings joy and happiness
In the orphanage home,we tour  the facilities, pwhere we saw the living quarters, kitchen, and classrooms
 We were impressed by the efforts of the caregivers to provide a clean, comfortable, and nurturing environment for the children.
I was really move and touched by all the good work and charity work of the caregivers.

We spent time with the children, engaging in various activities such as singing, dancing, and playing games. We also distributed gifts, including food, clothing, and educational materials, which brought immense joy to the children.
 https://img.inleo.io/DQmUkng2prktYwkjYinAvzBE2wvXAKAnVYrdzYUsULSE7QH/IMG_20241123_180402_674.jpg 
 https://img.inleo.io/DQmPgBBSmR2HewgJeQ1txGj9fvqV2R4tHnjmJ5knWzYefVC/IMG_20241123_180305_651.jpg 
 https://img.inleo.io/DQmSBB9BUcTXbv3Ld12T31wqXjpsC7ZfUj8ic4eRZhuLUHw/IMG_20241123_180332_301.jpg 
 https://img.inleo.io/DQmRgnDb71TEiQq7hdHV6TAWkhgG7WCpmZk7mKv9T6r73Y4/IMG_20241123_180336_836.jpg 

One of the most important and beautiful moments of our visit was when we had a session with the children, listening to their stories, hopes, and dreams. It was heartbreaking to hear about the difficulties they face, but inspiring to see their determination to succeed.

As we prepared to leave, the children gathered around us, thanking us for our visit and the gifts we brought. We, in turn, thanked them for allowing us to share in their lives and for reminding us of the importance of kindness, compassion, and generosity.

As we departed the center going back to Akwanga,we couldn't help but feel a great and wonderful sense of gratitude and humility. 
Our visit  to Rejoice academy for less privilege was a sobering reminder of the painful realities faced by many orphans,less privilege and  poor families in our society. However, it also help our commitment to making a positive contribution in our community and to supporting organizations that care for the poor and the Less privilege 
As we reflect on our visit, we are reminded of the need to  assist organizations that care for the poor, orphans, widows, and the Less privilege and to make a good contribution in our community. 
 I ,@ekojah  encourage everyone to see the vision of #HiveReachout to get involved, whether through volunteering, donating, or simply spreading awareness about the importance of caring for the less privileged and orphans.
### all pictures are mine.

body:
<center>![Hive_woodpeckers_in_wood_no_glass.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-woodpeckers/23x17DPrvaL6wAoitvyLvTSYTEUKFhKUCspfpzQK1tDwipqN5MBmgCa7M7HyQVcchQC5v.jpg)</center>

Good evening everyone and thankyou for stopping by.

**This Week's Activities**

This week we have been looking for some fun plans for our Christmas decoration haul that the kids want to start. There's been well into 10+ man hours of researching and they still can't decide what to start first. They have all the ideas but getting them to decide is near impossible so I think it's time I start making some decisions!

We have sanded more boards down which is taking an age and killing our backs and shoulders which is getting a bit tedious. Currently I am looking to find some way to do it easier and faster.

The doors the kids created last week are installed and holding up well against the wrath of my 2 year old son!
He is hellbent on getting back into the cupboard, but so far the doors have remained stead fast and sturdy and haven't budged. He's a hefty kid too, so I am so proud of the kids for making some great doors. 
Here's the link to that post if you missed it [Sturdy Doors](https://peakd.com/hive-177682/@hive-woodpeckers/the-doors-have-been-built-bfz)


![hivewoodpeckers_divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-woodpeckers/23w2cfiRiaBhThUYHrZecUbMBTHczVJJS8aL47k6mKxsbHY44EcvvRnonWfzCQSf6Va79.png)


**Other Bits**

We do currently have a bit of a setback due to the electrics keep tripping in the workshop. As of now there is no real exact reason as they seem to trip when we are using the tools but also randomly with no load except a freezer that was on the other side of the workshop. Sadly I hadn't noticed that the electrics had tripped and I have lost a few hundred pounds worth of food which I'm not best please about, but hey least it didn't catch fire like last time

Along with the recent cold weather, we actually managed to have the workshop a crisp -3 Degrees Celsius which is utter madness. I had never considered these temperature's and none of us have thermals and I cannot provide the kids with any new equipment until I raise a bit more money as they are quite expensive for the good stuff.
So we are back to using a small heater to try and keep us and the workshop a bit warmer. All the while due to the tripping electric's we have had to resort to hand saws for chopping up the wood ready for our future Christmas Decoration's. This has meant that it is really slow going as it's mainly just me who can saw well and in a straight line for a long period of time. The kids unfortunately cannot so my wood prep speed has vastly dropped.
Along with our frozen PVA wood glue (Who knew it would freeze!?!) which has left the workshop in anger via the door! We are back to waiting on more glue to arrive now, but it will be here for the next session in the week.

**Future Plans**

For now I have put on hold buying new equipment for the workshop. This does not include a reasonably priced Fire Extinguisher which I still need to buy, I just haven't got quite enough money yet for that. But it will be coming hopefully soon.

I am going to concentrate on getting the electric's sorted and safe for the kids as that is my priority at the moment. I want them to be warm, well fed and being able to use all the cool things that I get them, which currently I am only hitting the keep them a bit warm part.
I also am looking at ways to insulate the workshop on a tight budget to try and keep some of the heat in if possible. This will be great as it isn't even really winter yet in the UK and it's already mighty cold!
All of this costs money but eventually I hope that I can pull it off as I am willing to do whatever DIY that I can to make it better for them and to also keep the costs down to a minimum spend.

**Other News**

No new sponsors to announce this week. I have approached a couple more projects on HIVE for support, 1 is having a think and is going to get back to me. The other that replied at first has gone completely silent on me so I assume that means they aren't interested. Which is all fair, I just wish they had sent me a rejection so I could move on to another project that I have my eyes on.
I am trying to work with projects and groups that I feel could really bring some amazing support to the Hive-Woodpeckers, but also we could then bring some good support to them as well in a mutual benefit setup.

This next part is quite exciting for HIVE as I have officially managed to onboard 3 new members to HIVE solely through the Hive-Woodpeckers and what we are doing in advertising HIVE on our side.
The first was our eldest member. He has been a member of HIVE for a couple of months now and is absolutely destroying it!
I funded his account with $30 odd dollars worth of HIVE and gave him a run down on how things work. He was brand new to Crypto and I'm so proud how well he is doing. He has since turned that $30+ into well over $100+ with some smart trading and doing wonders with the community through blogging etc. 
It took a while to convince his parents that HIVE was the right place for him but they eventually relented and allowed him to join which was great!
He has managed to fund his school trip solely from the money he has made on HIVE which is amazing as this is his first trip he has ever been on with his school. He's made more money in the Crypto space than I have this year, and he's only been on a couple of months. I'm hoping he's gonna start teaching me soon!

The other 2 members are a parent of one of the kids in the group and one of the group leaders have joined to support us and support any members of the community that join HIVE. This is a great start for us and they even have bought over $100 of HIVE to get started. This is great for HIVE as I now have fulfilled a promise that I made to try and onboard members of our Charity group onto HIVE so I am hoping the @duo-curator team are happy so far with our work.
Just to add the cherry on top is that this has been achieved with a zero spend on advertising. This is solely through word of mouth and me spending my time interacting in my community and Charity group.
Hopefully by the New Year I'll have a few more I can shout about!

<center>![Hive_Woodpeckers_Logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-woodpeckers/AJbpkQZS7JpsQRKDdiKKpFGd6mQqRaw7G7GK5egmHjNWjtXYtJ7YF4LGyee2dFG.png)</center>

If you are reading this post and wondering who the [Hive-Woodpeckers](https://peakd.com/hive-177682/@hive-woodpeckers/introduction-to-the-hive-woodpeckers-3cg) are, click the link and check out our introduction post.

I want to say a massive thankyou to everyone who has supported us so far, from words of encouragement to upvotes. You are helping change kids lives and it is an amazing thing to be a part of.

author: bipolar95
body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWQmaUC55pR1YJXXAsZbne7t1zavy5tHp5hPUSqv55pF1/1732469860504.jpg)




***If I had a million dollars and I needed to spend it all on charitable acts, what would I spend it on?***

Well, it will interest y'all to know that it has been my biggest dream to industrialize the Niger Delta. It's quite unfortunate that with all our oil wealth, our region is plagued with widespread unemployment and poverty. 

Since we won't get any help from the government, I have been pulling my weight in my little way. Having worked with an NGO for seven years and with all the knowledge that I have gathered, if I have a million dollars, I will set up various industries based on the resources that are most prominent or available in the area. It could be fish farming and processing of fish into cans for the riverine area, it could be large-scale farming and packaging of finished food products. It could also be livestock for hide and leather, canned beef, milk and cheese. Basically, it is my intention to create something sustainable for development and poverty alleviation.

It's just that I don't know if it's because I'm an Economist or possibly because I have seen poverty play out first hand. But when it comes to charitable acts, I prefer it to be sustainable. You see, my first job experience was with an NGO, one I was actively involved in too. I handled a lot of projects from empowerment of the youth, Operation cloth, shelter and feeding the needy, educational and vocational scholarship, Educating the girl child etc.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcCM9quFkxXAEvwUQUUK2fk4eqRcoaXgMBXieod1PnVKh/1732469979992.jpg)





Personally, I hate to get involved in anything that will not serve in the long run. Everything that I do in the short run has always been aimed at a sustainable future in the long run. I have never really been a fan of handouts. I'd prefer people are taught how to fish than be handed fish. At one point, I had to write to the management to stop any handout program and channel all that money into something more sustainable and that was how the vocational scholarship plus youth empowerment program came about. 

For me, a thousand fed people today would all go hungry tomorrow, give a thousand youth a million naira each and over 90% of them will come back asking for more. But if you empower 10 youths and assist them with a business startup in their field of empowerment, you will be sure of them pushing through. Moreso, with the multiplier effect, these empowered youths can become an employer of labor. Thus recruiting more people and providing them with a source of earning. 

I remember when we first started our empowerment programme, it was a disaster. The first launch of the programme was not handled by me. After the selection process, candidates  were asked to go look for their area of vocation, then come and enter it into the office registry. After registering it at the office, one of our officials will now follow them to the various training centers and pay the required amount for them to start. Everything was put in place and the required fee was paid. We all thought the programme was sailing smoothly till it was time for the first inspection of our various candidates. During that inspection, we found out that the majority of our beneficiaries had absconded from training. 

We also later discovered that most of the beneficiaries of the skill acquisition program did a kill and divide with the trainers. Our MD was so upset that he wanted to cancel the program but I pleaded with him because that program was my brain child. I saw that it's something beautiful and a lot of people will benefit from it. As a development economist, I am all about poverty alleviation and anything to reduce poverty to the barest minimum.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaCDeKF5QGcDdsM62JLrniEcXRUuwMkwCPzHmThXfxdbk/1732469980067.jpg)

I had to restructure and promised my boss that I will see to it personally that every money channeled into the program is adequately utilized and if I fail, he can scrap the program. I dropped all other engagement and focused on the skill acquisition program. First, I interviewed all the candidates myself. I commissioned a trusted team who went to source for the centers that the candidates will train in after which an agreement was drafted between our foundation and the various training centers to rule out foul play like the last time.

For the beneficiaries, we reached an agreement that upon completion, the candidates with the most satisfactory performance will get a business set up from the NGO but then a small percentage will come back to the foundation. 

Amazingly, our second test run was successful and I really outdid myself.


**ALL IMAGES ARE MINE**

author: preciousgold
body:
Hello everyone, Good morning and welcome to my blog special thanks to the @hivereachout for a wonderful prompt  They influence one's attitudes, behavior, and perception of oneself. One's attitude, behavior, and perception toward oneself are influenced as well.
Thus, confidence and high self-esteem may play roles in all aspects of human life relationship-wise to achieving career success.


![board-2433982_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/preciousgold/23w2kpwDvTThWHZqYMz6dgitg29rHmrNU78rHFPYLCapGrk36q7yj4gLbhS7rXemDBsU4.jpg)[source](
https://pixabay.com/photos/board-school-dreams-make-to-do-2433982/)


Confidence is the entire assurance in oneself coupled with capabilities. It manifests as a feeling that one can be able to face challenges, make judgments, or face any risks. Self-confident people are most likely going to grab opportunities. They will speak up for themselves and pursue goals with determination. Hence, confidence helps one overcome setbacks and failures, since one is all the time convinced that easy resilience and continuation will be possible.

Self-esteem, on the other hand, is the total subjective estimation of how much worth one has and values being a person; it is that internal belief in eligibility for love, accolade, and success by a person. High self-esteem people are less affected by criticism and rejection since they possess internal self-worth which is hard to shatter. They are likely to communicate boundaries, self-advocate, and prioritize their needs.

Thus, confidence and self-esteem are really connected because one's belief in his abilities usually depends on his sense of self-worth. If a person has confidence in herself and gives importance to her worth, she is very likely to take risks, pursue her dream, and assert herself in different situations.

However, building confidence and keeping it is not so easy. Many things can change the perception of the self, and dimensions such as past experiences, social comparison, and society's standards come into one's life. Conditions like negative self-talk, perfectionism, and fear of failure also create resentment in individuals.

You can certainly increase your self-confidence and self-esteem. One way is through self-care and self-love. Taking care of one's body, mind, and emotions can have individuals feeling better about who they are and what they can do. Happiness and fulfillment can be derived from activities that take up time and build one's self-esteem and social confidence. 

So, achieving possible realistic goals is a good source of self-esteem boost, as well as appreciating small milestones achieved and wins along the way, thus keeping a positive self-image. On the other hand, sharing space with supportive, uplifting people often results in upward-moving self-confidence and esteem because healthy relationships foster validation and reassurance. 

Confidence and self-esteem can be developed through activities that tease a little bit into one's comfort zone; they may take risks outside of their comfort zone, thus giving way to growth and self-confidence. Trying to learn new things, do different things, and dare to face fears are all ways to feel competence and self-worth. 

These two qualities are the ultimate assets in the lives of individuals, making every individual's life successful and fulfilled. With self-care, goals, relationships, and challenges taken on, people build a great degree of worth in themselves and their capabilities. They don't have fixed traits but can be developed and honed for life through consistent practice.




Posted Using [InLeo Alpha](https://inleo.io/@preciousgold/trusting-yourself--l6m)

author: kbv.animalwelf
body:
It was over a year ago when I did a feature on a very unusual and friendly dog that lives at the tippy top of the Tiger Cave Temple and how he had become a bit of a celebrity to locals and even a bit of a blip on the international news radar. [The story](https://peakd.com/hive-141359/@kbv.animalwelf/panther-the-dog-that-lives-1260-steps-up-the-mountain) was a very light-hearted and happy piece because despite where Panther had chosen to live at the top of nearly 1400 stairs, it was pretty amazing how approachable and friendly (as well as healthy) that he was. Unfortunately, things have taken a turn for the worse and there are some signs that could be a learning moment for dog lovers out there.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kbv.animalwelf/23xyUoe5tBg9xhSZXDbpMnVsN1yzN2zECCJET38wC9BDdRY7735sYeHtKqU116RHUPyNd.png)
Panther was and is something really special because he was very aware of the fact that food and attention was in much greater supply at the foot of this mountain temple, but for reasons that we don't understand he chose one day to follow a monk who does daily sweeping of the stairs, all the way up to the top, and then just decided that was where he wanted to stay. He rarely comes back down and if you are to walk these stairs one day, it is easy to understand how exhausting this journey actually is.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kbv.animalwelf/23y8mipbrUMX5oL9pct6KEN8gs67Fc5asbnsFkBxUZcq1WgB4boFBg8ppaEY178cgGjT3.png)
There were multiple instances where volunteers from Krabi Animal Welfare as well as the monks, attempted to coax Panther back down to the bottom and every now and then someone would succeed. But Panther must just really prefer the isolation at the top because it was always just a day or so before he returned to his mountain top lie down spots. It is a very long way to the top but there is access to drinking water and since the monks are aware he is up there, food is brought to him every day by the people who tidy up the sacred area at the top.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kbv.animalwelf/243zba6wxwLqbmvJ8YH5XyR1oMNSngEWSuXVvaYPTPdXDGdmsiv1X4zY3U8bUtjFAtPgk.png) [src](https://www.adventographer.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/DJI_0559.jpg)
It was very unfortunate to find out one day from the monks that Panther has lost a lot of weight and is on many days refusing to eat and sometimes he has become a bit aggressive towards some people that try to approach him. It is rare that he actually lashes out at anyone, but this being a very popular tourist attraction and a very relevant Buddhist monument, they can't have a dangerous dog threatening the visitors.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kbv.animalwelf/23ywyv54Fy9baeq3KCL6W2dJ22fM1a9i1LKRXYrut2LRnb48VMnEwEEbzqwXYKe3ZwpXC.png)
We simply cannot troubleshoot what is wrong with him or administer any sort of remedy or treatment where he is now, so we have put out a request to anyone that is up there to attempt to carry Panther down from the top. Normally we would just leave these dogs alone, but Panther is a special case and clearly has something wrong with him. He is not young, but he also isn't terribly old. We don't really know how old he is but we've been familiar with him for several years. It was kind of heartwarming when we put the message out to the local community and on social media asking for help in finding and potentially carrying him from the top that within just a few days dozens of people responded saying that they would be happy to help. Unfortunately, several of the helpers reported back that they couldn't find Panther on the stairs or at the top, so we haven't been able to relocate him. The search is continuing because there aren't very many places to go up there. There is only one pathway and going off the path is a treacherous cliffside that is only traversable by the monkeys that live there and even they only go a couple hundred meters from the ground. Basically the area towards the top isn't very hospitable to life, and we are starting to get worried about Panther and what might have happened to him. The search is continuing, and we hope in the next few days to have some good news about this relatively famous dog of the Tiger Cave Temple. Just so you know, when a dog changes their temperament suddenly, or starts refusing to eat despite the fact that they really should be hungry, this is time to get a veterinarian involved. There are a wide variety of reasons why a dog would suddenly change their attitude and eating habits, but normally it has something to do with their digestive system or how their body processes food. All dog owners already know that dogs seem to be interested in food like nothing else, so when they all of a sudden stop, you should monitor them closely and if it doesn't sort itself out in a couple of days - which is quite common - you really should get some blood tests done because what is going on inside the dog could be slowly, or quickly, killing them. I will report back on Panther as soon as we have any information. For the time being, we are all quite worried about this.
if you would like to see how you can help out or simply spread the word, please visit our website at

http://krabianimalwelfare.org

![21462758_174743779763179_4154543215066704521_n.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmXHEhXj4e6AzsbAJKsFo8csozuoq1uUcMSdFQTYifzi55/21462758_174743779763179_4154543215066704521_n.jpg)
Krabi Animal Welfare is a charity run entirely by volunteers and are a registered non-profit organization in Thailand and the U.K.. We aim to relieve the pain and suffering of dogs and cats within Krabi Province. เป็นผู้สนับสนุนรายเดือนหรือบริจาคครั้งเดียวได้ที่: http://krabianimalwelfare.org
